description: This file defines a React component 'ActionList' and associated rendering utilities for displaying a list of actions in a trace viewer UI, including tree view interactions, rendering of action titles, and attachment handling.

classes.name: ActionTreeView
classes.description: A TreeView component specialized for ActionTreeItem elements, used to display the hierarchical list of actions.

methods.name: renderAction
methods.description: Renders a visual representation of an action, including its duration, icons, badges, and attachments.

methods.name: renderTitleForCall
methods.description: Generates a React element and a string title for an action call, parsing placeholders and parameters.
